task.task: Synthesize a typed structural-feature and numeric-ranking heuristic for maximum-weight independent-set repair, starting from the shared warm seed. Use permitted polynomial operations on the current active graph; fixed vertices remain selected and excluded vertices unavailable. Maximize equal-family complete-schedule reward divided by total graph weight under the unchanged 0.5-second wall/200000-work repair budget. Program priority influences only the feasible greedy proposal and pivot. Do not use ID or benchmark lookup, external state, imports, model or oracle calls. Name/rationale describe the thought; features/rule execute.

typed_grammar.rule: Numeric feature names/constants; +,-,*,/, unary signs; numeric comparisons, and/or/not, conditional expressions; min/max with1..8arguments and abs with1argument; finite constants with absolute value<=1e9; no imports, attributes, loops or arbitrary function calls

packet.output: Exactly one FeatureRuleProgram JSON object: name,features,rule,rationale; no batch

program.name: compact_feasible_completion
program.rationale: Collapse the correlated residual packing and cover estimates into one feasible completion estimate, merging their coefficients. Remove the overlapping residual, neighborhood and boundary edge corrections, reducing six features to two and avoiding repeated induced-edge scans and clique-cover construction. Retain the neighborhood packing penalty as a local opportunity-cost estimate. Bound and weight-scale the degree tie break so it cannot grow without limit or change priorities under uniform weight rescaling. All structural computations use the current active graph.
